newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Columnist seeks handcuffs for Hong Kong handover.
newsitem.headline: Columnist seeks handcuffs for Hong Kong handover.

text.p: Gossip columnist Nury Vittachi plans to spend the handover of Hong Kong to China handcuffed to someone other than his wife.
He expects scores of non-couples to follow suit.
"I've asked the Hong Kong police if I can hire 50 sets of handcuffs," Vittachi said on Wednesday.
He said people taking part would have to be handcuffed to a stranger for a 24-hour period straddling the handover of the British colony at midnight on June 30.
Vittachi calls the event "hands across the border", symbolising two cultures getting to know each other.
The idea might seem farfetched, but he says people are interested.
"It's for charity," Vittachi said. "The couples involved, who must never have slept together, have to find sponsors."
"If they don't make it (through 24 hours), they have to buy out the sponsors."
"I've been asking for volunteers. I thought the response would come mostly from the younger, wilder types. But it's the older, married (couples) who seem keener on this."
